options.content:
BioETL Overview

Primary question: what is currently broken or degraded in BioETL, and where should the operator drill down first?

Scope: pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, selected Grafana time range. No green OK is shown without recent activity. Owner: sre-data-platform.

panels.title: System Status
panels.description: Thresholds: BROKEN when runtime blocker>0, DQ hard fail>0, or control-plane blocker>0; DEGRADED on warning-only signals; UNKNOWN when no recent samples. Next action: open dashboard indicated by Next Action (Runtime first, then Control Plane, DQ, Provider, Workflow).

panels.title: Next Action

no_recent_activity_or_unknown_state.text: No recent activity or unknown state

panels.description: Action route projection. The row exposes `action_target`, `action_reason`, and `action_dashboard_uid`; Runtime > Control Plane > DQ > Provider > Workflow > Monitor. Pipeline scope is explicit; DQ/provider routes remain broader than run_type when the underlying signal is global.

panels.title: L0 Inputs
panels.description: Current L0 inputs (Runtime, DQ, Gold, Control Plane, Provider, Workflow). Value mapping: 0/null=UNKNOWN, 1=OK, 2=DEGRADED, 3=BROKEN.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers Current
panels.description: Current runtime blocker summary only; no $__range evidence. Open Runtime dashboard for the exact blocker condition rows.

panels.title: DQ Status Current
panels.description: Pipeline-scoped DQ summary across run types for the selected pipeline. Value mapping: 0/null=UNKNOWN, 1=OK, 2=DEGRADED, 3=BROKEN.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle Current
panels.description: Lifecycle-state projection for gold output. `lifecycle_state` distinguishes runtime-owned failure, missing gold after success, pending, disabled, and healthy recent gold.

panels.title: Control Plane Current
panels.description: Current control-plane summary for manifest, ledger, checkpoint, and lineage guardrails. Open Control Plane for the exact failing contract.

panels.title: Provider GLOBAL Scope
panels.description: GLOBAL provider scope across pipelines. This panel intentionally ignores selected pipeline/run_type filters.

panels.title: Workflow GLOBAL Scope
panels.description: GLOBAL workflow scope across pipeline/run_type combinations.

panels.title: Historical Failures (range evidence)
panels.description: Historical evidence only. Keeps `pipeline` and `run_type` labels from the active Grafana window.

panels.title: Recent terminal runs (range evidence)
panels.description: Historical terminal-run evidence only. Keeps `pipeline`, `run_type`, and `status` labels from the active Grafana window.

options.content: Use top-level links for logs and traces. Raw metric starting points for this dashboard are bioetl_l0_status{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}, bioetl_l0_next_action_route{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}, and bioetl_l0_input_status{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}. Historical evidence stays in the row above; exact blocker reasons live in the Runtime, DQ, Provider Health, Control Plane, and Workflow dashboards.
